environment.background_note: Existing desktop and unrelated contexts retained; no clock/power changes.

benchmark.cache: same arrays reused; no explicit flush
benchmark.order: three sequential passes; rotate configuration order by 3 each pass
benchmark.correctness: NaN-prefilled precheck and postcheck; finite output; abs error <= 1e-6

profile.scope: separate rocprofv3 kernel and HIP API trace; excluded from benchmark
profile.filtering: all dispatches retained; inspect_trace selects one kernel name, sorts timestamps, skips 6 and keeps 10

profile_driver.reason: Profile subprocesses run without initializing the GPU in the parent process; initial failed profiler logs retained separately.

analysis.identity_check: frozen source and binary; runtime ENV; expected matrix and metadata; prior sample/log hashes

statistics.across_processes: median of process medians; min/max of process medians
